verses.original: וַיִּזְכֹּ֤ר אֱלֹהִים֙ אֶת־ נֹ֔חַ וְאֵ֤ת כָּל־ הַֽחַיָּה֙ וְאֶת־ כָּל־ הַבְּהֵמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר אִתּ֖וֹ בַּתֵּבָ֑ה וַיַּעֲבֵ֨ר אֱלֹהִ֥ים ר֙וּחַ֙ עַל־ הָאָ֔רֶץ וַיָּשֹׁ֖כּוּ הַמָּֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiz·kōr ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’eṯ- nō·aḥ wə·’êṯ kāl- ha·ḥay·yāh wə·’eṯ- kāl- hab·bə·hê·māh ’ă·šer ’it·tōw bat·tê·ḇāh way·ya·‘ă·ḇêr ’ĕ·lō·hîm rū·aḥ ‘al- hā·’ā·reṣ way·yā·šōk·kū ham·mā·yim
verses.literal: But God remembered Noah and all the animals and livestock that were with him in the ark And God sent a wind . . . over the earth and the waters began to subside
verses.literalPt: Deus lembrou-se de Noé, de todos os animais e de todo o gado que estavam com ele na arca; Deus fez passar um vento sobre a terra, e as águas se diminuíram.

verses.original: וַיִּסָּֽכְרוּ֙ מַעְיְנֹ֣ת תְּה֔וֹם וַֽאֲרֻבֹּ֖ת הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם וַיִּכָּלֵ֥א הַגֶּ֖שֶׁם מִן־ הַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yis·sā·ḵə·rū ma‘·yə·nōṯ tə·hō·wm wa·’ă·rub·bōṯ haš·šā·mā·yim way·yik·kā·lê hag·ge·šem min- haš·šā·mā·yim
verses.literal: The springs of the deep and the floodgates of the heavens were closed and the rain from the sky was restrained
verses.literalPt: Fecharam-se as fontes do abismo e as janelas do céu, e foram retidas do céu as copiosas chuvas.

verses.original: וַיָּשֻׁ֧בוּ הַמַּ֛יִם מֵעַ֥ל הָאָ֖רֶץ הָל֣וֹךְ וָשׁ֑וֹב וַיַּחְסְר֣וּ הַמַּ֔יִם מִקְצֵ֕ה חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים וּמְאַ֖ת יֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·šu·ḇū ham·ma·yim mê·‘al hā·’ā·reṣ hā·lō·wḵ wā·šō·wḇ way·yaḥ·sə·rū ham·ma·yim miq·ṣêh ḥă·miš·šîm ū·mə·’aṯ yō·wm
verses.literal: The waters receded steadily . . . from the earth and after 150 . . . days the waters had gone down
verses.literalPt: Iam-se as águas retirando continuamente de cima da terra e, no fim de cento e cinquenta dias, as águas minguaram.

verses.original: וַתָּ֤נַח הַתֵּבָה֙ בַּחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔י בְּשִׁבְעָה־ עָשָׂ֥ר י֖וֹם לַחֹ֑דֶשׁ עַ֖ל הָרֵ֥י אֲרָרָֽט׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tā·naḥ hat·tê·ḇāh ba·ḥō·ḏeš haš·šə·ḇî·‘î bə·šiḇ·‘āh- ‘ā·śār yō·wm la·ḥō·ḏeš ‘al hā·rê ’ă·rā·rāṭ
verses.literal: On the seventeenth . . . day of the seventh month the ark came to rest on the mountains of Ararat
verses.literalPt: No sétimo mês, no dia dezessete do mês, repousou a arca sobre os montes de Ararate.

verses.original: וְהַמַּ֗יִם הָיוּ֙ הָל֣וֹךְ וְחָס֔וֹר עַ֖ד הַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הָֽעֲשִׂירִ֑י בָּֽעֲשִׂירִי֙ בְּאֶחָ֣ד לַחֹ֔דֶשׁ נִרְא֖וּ רָאשֵׁ֥י הֶֽהָרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ham·ma·yim hā·yū hā·lō·wḵ wə·ḥā·sō·wr ‘aḏ ha·ḥō·ḏeš hā·‘ă·śî·rî bā·‘ă·śî·rî bə·’e·ḥāḏ la·ḥō·ḏeš nir·’ū rā·šê he·hā·rîm
verses.literal: And the waters . . . continued to recede until the tenth month and on the first day of the tenth month the tops of the mountains became visible
verses.literalPt: As águas iam diminuindo continuamente até o décimo mês; no décimo mês, no primeiro dia do mês, foram vistos os cumes dos montes.

verses.original: וַֽיְהִ֕י מִקֵּ֖ץ אַרְבָּעִ֣ים י֑וֹם וַיִּפְתַּ֣ח נֹ֔חַ אֶת־ חַלּ֥וֹן הַתֵּבָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָֽׂה׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî miq·qêṣ ’ar·bā·‘îm yō·wm way·yip̄·taḥ nō·aḥ ’eṯ- ḥal·lō·wn hat·tê·ḇāh ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh
verses.literal: After forty days Noah opened the window he had made in the ark
verses.literalPt: Passados quarenta dias, abriu Noé a janela que havia feito na arca;

verses.original: וַיְשַׁלַּ֖ח אֶת־ הָֽעֹרֵ֑ב וַיֵּצֵ֤א יָצוֹא֙ וָשׁ֔וֹב עַד־ יְבֹ֥שֶׁת הַמַּ֖יִם מֵעַ֥ל הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: way·šal·laḥ ’eṯ- hā·‘ō·rêḇ way·yê·ṣê yā·ṣō·w wā·šō·wḇ ‘aḏ- yə·ḇō·šeṯ ham·ma·yim mê·‘al hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: and sent out a raven It kept flying back and forth . . . . . . until the waters had dried up from the earth
verses.literalPt: soltou um corvo que, saindo, ia e voltava, até que as águas se secaram de sobre a face da terra.

verses.original: וַיְשַׁלַּ֥ח אֶת־ הַיּוֹנָ֖ה מֵאִתּ֑וֹ לִרְאוֹת֙ הֲקַ֣לּוּ הַמַּ֔יִם מֵעַ֖ל פְּנֵ֥י הָֽאֲדָמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·šal·laḥ ’eṯ- hay·yō·w·nāh mê·’it·tōw lir·’ō·wṯ hă·qal·lū ham·ma·yim mê·‘al pə·nê hā·’ă·ḏā·māh
verses.literal: Then Noah sent out - a dove to see if the waters had receded from the surface of the ground
verses.literalPt: Depois, soltou uma pomba, para ver se as águas tinham minguado de sobre a face da terra;

verses.original: וְלֹֽא־ מָצְאָה֩ הַיּוֹנָ֨ה מָנ֜וֹחַ לְכַף־ רַגְלָ֗הּ וַתָּ֤שָׁב אֵלָיו֙ אֶל־ הַתֵּבָ֔ה כִּי־ מַ֖יִם עַל־ פְּנֵ֣י כָל־ הָאָ֑רֶץ וַיִּשְׁלַ֤ח יָדוֹ֙ וַיִּקָּחֶ֔הָ וַיָּבֵ֥א אֹתָ֛הּ אֵלָ֖יו אֶל־ הַתֵּבָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō- mā·ṣə·’āh hay·yō·w·nāh mā·nō·w·aḥ lə·ḵap̄- raḡ·lāh wat·tā·šāḇ ’ê·lāw ’el- hat·tê·ḇāh kî- ma·yim ‘al- pə·nê ḵāl hā·’ā·reṣ way·yiš·laḥ yā·ḏōw way·yiq·qā·ḥe·hā way·yā·ḇê ’ō·ṯāh ’ê·lāw ’el- hat·tê·ḇāh
verses.literal: But the dove found no place to rest her foot . . . and she returned to him in the ark because the waters were still covering the surface of all the earth So he reached out his hand . . . and brought her back inside the ark
verses.literalPt: mas a pomba não achou onde pousar a planta do pé e voltou a ele, para a arca; porque as águas ainda cobriam a face da terra. Noé, estendendo a mão, tomou-a e a fez recolher na arca.

verses.original: וַיָּ֣חֶל ע֔וֹד שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֖ים אֲחֵרִ֑ים וַיֹּ֛סֶף שַׁלַּ֥ח אֶת־ הַיּוֹנָ֖ה מִן־ הַתֵּבָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḥel ‘ō·wḏ šiḇ·‘aṯ yā·mîm ’ă·ḥê·rîm way·yō·sep̄ šal·laḥ ’eṯ- hay·yō·w·nāh min- hat·tê·ḇāh
verses.literal: Noah waited . . . seven more days and again sent out the dove from the ark
verses.literalPt: Esperou ainda outros sete dias e, de novo, soltou a pomba para fora da arca.

verses.original: וַתָּבֹ֨א אֵלָ֤יו הַיּוֹנָה֙ לְעֵ֣ת עֶ֔רֶב וְהִנֵּ֥ה עֲלֵה־ זַ֖יִת טָרָ֣ף בְּפִ֑יהָ וַיֵּ֣דַע נֹ֔חַ כִּי־ קַ֥לּוּ הַמַּ֖יִם מֵעַ֥ל הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tā·ḇō ’ê·lāw hay·yō·w·nāh lə·‘êṯ ‘e·reḇ wə·hin·nêh ‘ă·lêh- za·yiṯ ṭā·rāp̄ bə·p̄î·hā way·yê·ḏa‘ nō·aḥ kî- qal·lū ham·ma·yim mê·‘al hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: And behold the dove returned to him in the evening . . . with a freshly plucked olive leaf in her beak So Noah knew that the waters had receded from the earth
verses.literalPt: À tarde, a pomba voltou para ele, e eis no seu bico uma folha verde de oliveira; assim soube Noé que as águas tinham minguado de sobre a terra.

verses.original: וַיִּיָּ֣חֶל ע֔וֹד שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֖ים אֲחֵרִ֑ים וַיְשַׁלַּח֙ אֶת־ הַיּוֹנָ֔ה וְלֹֽא־ יָסְפָ֥ה שׁוּב־ אֵלָ֖יו עֽוֹד׃
verses.transliteration: way·yî·yā·ḥel ‘ō·wḏ šiḇ·‘aṯ yā·mîm ’ă·ḥê·rîm way·šal·laḥ ’eṯ- hay·yō·w·nāh wə·lō- yā·sə·p̄āh šūḇ- ’ê·lāw ‘ō·wḏ
verses.literal: And Noah waited . . . seven more days and sent out the dove again but this time . . . . . . she did not return to him
verses.literalPt: Então, esperou ainda outros sete dias e enviou a pomba; porém ela não voltou mais para ele.

verses.original: וַֽ֠יְהִי בְּאַחַ֨ת וְשֵׁשׁ־ מֵא֜וֹת שָׁנָ֗ה בָּֽרִאשׁוֹן֙ בְּאֶחָ֣ד לַחֹ֔דֶשׁ חָֽרְב֥וּ הַמַּ֖יִם מֵעַ֣ל הָאָ֑רֶץ וַיָּ֤סַר נֹ֙חַ֙ אֶת־ מִכְסֵ֣ה הַתֵּבָ֔ה וַיַּ֕רְא וְהִנֵּ֥ה חָֽרְב֖וּ פְּנֵ֥י הָֽאֲדָמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî bə·’a·ḥaṯ wə·šêš- mê·’ō·wṯ šā·nāh bā·ri·šō·wn bə·’e·ḥāḏ la·ḥō·ḏeš ḥā·rə·ḇū ham·ma·yim mê·‘al hā·’ā·reṣ way·yā·sar nō·aḥ ’eṯ- miḵ·sêh hat·tê·ḇāh way·yar wə·hin·nêh ḥā·rə·ḇū pə·nê hā·’ă·ḏā·māh
verses.literal: In Noah’s six hundred and first year on the first day of the first month the waters had dried up from the earth So Noah removed the covering from the ark and saw . . . that the surface of the ground was dry
verses.literalPt: No ano seiscentos e um, no primeiro mês, no primeiro dia do mês, secaram-se as águas de cima da terra e, tirando a coberta da arca, olhou Noé, e eis que a face da terra estava enxuta.

verses.original: וּבַחֹ֙דֶשׁ֙ הַשֵּׁנִ֔י בְּשִׁבְעָ֧ה וְעֶשְׂרִ֛ים י֖וֹם לַחֹ֑דֶשׁ יָבְשָׁ֖ה הָאָֽרֶץ׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇa·ḥō·ḏeš haš·šê·nî bə·šiḇ·‘āh wə·‘eś·rîm yō·wm la·ḥō·ḏeš yā·ḇə·šāh hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: By the twenty-seventh . . . day . . . of the second month the earth was fully dry
verses.literalPt: No segundo mês, aos vinte e sete dias do mês, a terra estava seca.

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֶל־ נֹ֥חַ לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’el- nō·aḥ lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then God said to Noah . . .
verses.literalPt: Então, disse Deus a Noé:

verses.original: צֵ֖א מִן־ הַתֵּבָ֑ה אַתָּ֕ה וְאִשְׁתְּךָ֛ וּבָנֶ֥יךָ וּנְשֵֽׁי־ בָנֶ֖יךָ אִתָּֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: ṣê min- hat·tê·ḇāh ’at·tāh wə·’iš·tə·ḵā ū·ḇā·ne·ḵā ū·nə·šê- ḇā·ne·ḵā ’it·tāḵ
verses.literal: Come out of the ark you and your wife along with your sons and their wives
verses.literalPt: Sai da arca, tu com tua mulher, teus filhos e as mulheres de teus filhos.

verses.original: כָּל־ הַחַיָּ֨ה אֲשֶֽׁר־ אִתְּךָ֜ מִכָּל־ בָּשָׂ֗ר בָּע֧וֹף וּבַבְּהֵמָ֛ה וּבְכָל־ הָרֶ֛מֶשׂ הָרֹמֵ֥שׂ עַל־ הָאָ֖רֶץ הוֹצֵא אִתָּ֑ךְ וְשָֽׁרְצ֣וּ בָאָ֔רֶץ וּפָר֥וּ וְרָב֖וּ עַל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- ha·ḥay·yāh ’ă·šer- ’it·tə·ḵā mik·kāl bā·śār bā·‘ō·wp̄ ū·ḇab·bə·hê·māh ū·ḇə·ḵāl hā·re·meś hā·rō·mêś ‘al- hā·’ā·reṣ hō·ṣē ’it·tāḵ wə·šā·rə·ṣū ḇā·’ā·reṣ ū·p̄ā·rū wə·rā·ḇū ‘al- hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Bring out . . . all the living creatures . . . . . . that are with you birds livestock and everything that crawls upon the ground so that they can spread out over the earth and be fruitful and multiply upon it
verses.literalPt: Faze também sair a todos os animais que estão contigo, de toda a carne, tanto aves como gado e todo o réptil que se arrasta sobre a terra; para que se reproduzam abundantemente na terra, frutifiquem e se multipliquem sobre ela.

verses.original: וַיֵּ֖צֵא־ נֹ֑חַ וּבָנָ֛יו וְאִשְׁתּ֥וֹ וּנְשֵֽׁי־ בָנָ֖יו אִתּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·ṣê- nō·aḥ ū·ḇā·nāw wə·’iš·tōw ū·nə·šê- ḇā·nāw ’it·tōw
verses.literal: So Noah came out along with his sons and his wife and his sons’ wives
verses.literalPt: Saíram, pois, Noé, seus filhos, sua mulher e as mulheres de seus filhos.

verses.original: כָּל־ הַֽחַיָּ֗ה כָּל־ הָרֶ֙מֶשׂ֙ וְכָל־ הָע֔וֹף כֹּ֖ל רוֹמֵ֣שׂ עַל־ הָאָ֑רֶץ לְמִשְׁפְּחֹ֣תֵיהֶ֔ם יָצְא֖וּ מִן־ הַתֵּבָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- ha·ḥay·yāh kāl- hā·re·meś wə·ḵāl hā·‘ō·wp̄ kōl rō·w·mêś ‘al- hā·’ā·reṣ lə·miš·pə·ḥō·ṯê·hem yā·ṣə·’ū min- hat·tê·ḇāh
verses.literal: Every living creature every creeping thing and every bird everything that moves upon the earth came out of the ark kind by kind
verses.literalPt: Todo o animal, todo o réptil, toda a ave, tudo o que se move sobre a terra, segundo as suas famílias, saíram da arca.

verses.original: וַיִּ֥בֶן נֹ֛חַ מִזְבֵּ֖חַ לַֽיהוָ֑ה וַיִּקַּ֞ח מִכֹּ֣ל׀ הַבְּהֵמָ֣ה הַטְּהוֹרָ֗ה וּמִכֹּל֙ הָע֣וֹף הַטָּהֹ֔ר וַיַּ֥עַל עֹלֹ֖ת בַּמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yi·ḇen nō·aḥ miz·bê·aḥ Yah·weh way·yiq·qaḥ mik·kōl hab·bə·hê·māh haṭ·ṭə·hō·w·rāh ū·mik·kōl hā·‘ō·wp̄ haṭ·ṭā·hōr way·ya·‘al ‘ō·lōṯ bam·miz·bê·aḥ
verses.literal: Then Noah built an altar to the LORD And taking from every kind of clean animal and clean bird he offered burnt offerings on the altar
verses.literalPt: Edificou Noé um altar a Jeová; tomou de todo o animal limpo e de toda a ave limpa e ofereceu holocaustos sobre o altar.

verses.original: וַיָּ֣רַח יְהוָה֮ אֶת־ רֵ֣יחַ הַנִּיחֹחַ֒ וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל־ לִבּ֗וֹ לֹֽא־ אֹ֠סִף לְקַלֵּ֨ל ע֤וֹד אֶת־ הָֽאֲדָמָה֙ בַּעֲב֣וּר הָֽאָדָ֔ם כִּ֠י יֵ֣צֶר לֵ֧ב הָאָדָ֛ם רַ֖ע מִנְּעֻרָ֑יו וְלֹֽא־ אֹסִ֥ף ע֛וֹד לְהַכּ֥וֹת אֶת־ כָּל־ חַ֖י כַּֽאֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשִֽׂיתִי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·raḥ Yah·weh ’eṯ- rê·aḥ han·nî·ḥō·aḥ way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’el- lib·bōw lō- ’ō·sip̄ lə·qal·lêl ‘ō·wḏ ’eṯ- hā·’ă·ḏā·māh ba·‘ă·ḇūr hā·’ā·ḏām kî yê·ṣer lêḇ hā·’ā·ḏām ra‘ min·nə·‘u·rāw wə·lō- ’ō·sip̄ ‘ō·wḏ lə·hak·kō·wṯ ’eṯ- kāl- ḥay ka·’ă·šer ‘ā·śî·ṯî
verses.literal: When the LORD smelled the pleasing aroma He said in His heart Never again . . . . . . will I curse the ground because of man even though every inclination of his heart is evil from his youth And never again . . . will I destroy all living creatures as I have done
verses.literalPt: Sentiu Jeová o suave cheiro e disse no seu coração: Não tornarei mais a amaldiçoar a terra por causa do homem, pois a imaginação do coração do homem é má desde a sua mocidade; nem tornarei mais a ferir todo o vivente, como acabo de fazer.

verses.original: עֹ֖ד כָּל־ יְמֵ֣י הָאָ֑רֶץ זֶ֡רַע וְ֠קָצִיר וְקֹ֨ר וָחֹ֜ם וְקַ֧יִץ וָחֹ֛רֶף וְי֥וֹם וָלַ֖יְלָה לֹ֥א יִשְׁבֹּֽתוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ōḏ kāl- yə·mê hā·’ā·reṣ ze·ra‘ wə·qā·ṣîr wə·qōr wā·ḥōm wə·qa·yiṣ wā·ḥō·rep̄ wə·yō·wm wā·lay·lāh lō yiš·bō·ṯū
verses.literal: As long as . . . the earth endures seedtime and harvest cold and heat summer and winter day and night shall never cease
verses.literalPt: Enquanto durar a terra, não deixará de haver sementeira e ceifa, frio e calor, verão e inverno, dia e noite.
